candidate.claim: High failure-prediction accuracy does not imply beneficial execution-time intervention; deployment value depends on recovery versus disruption of trajectories.

primary_source.title: Accurate Failure Prediction in Agents Does Not Imply Effective Failure Prevention

critic_setup.task_disjoint_split: 158 train / 19 validation / 21 test unique tasks; zero task overlap
critic_setup.ALFWorld: complete domain transfer for critic weights; no ALFWorld trajectories in critic training

disruption_recovery_framework.definitions: p=baseline failure rate, r=recovery rate among baseline failures, d=disruption rate among baseline successes
disruption_recovery_framework.scope: pilot estimates are used as a pre-deployment directional test; they are not population-invariant constants

critic_scaling.clarification: This supports 'scaling critic size did not improve AUROC in this data/config regime', not a general inverse scaling claim.

scope_clarifications: Detector AUROC/F1 and intervention utility are distinct objectives. The paper's causal intervention evidence is specific to the tested base agents, benchmarks, ROLLBACK/APPEND mechanics, thresholds/calibration, action budget and intervention budget.

ALFWorld is zero-shot transfer for the critic weights, but temperature scaling is fitted on ALFWorld validation data; calling the entire deployed intervention pipeline fully zero-shot would be too broad.

The worker's 'best intervention' values are correctly taken as the best of the four Table-4 intervention cells for each model/benchmark. They should not be confused with the pilot's larger +4.7pp ROLLBACK improvement reported for Qwen ALFWorld; the full 202-task Table-4 best is +2.8pp uncalibrated APPEND.

The p/r/d threshold is a matched-outcome accounting framework for this intervention setting, not proof that any monitor with the same p/r/d estimates will behave identically under a different intervention mechanism.

The paper reports paired task-level bootstrap testing and Holm-Bonferroni correction across intervention conditions per benchmark-model pair; downstream summaries should avoid treating every raw cell difference as independently significant.
confidence: high for primary paper setup, tables and framework; no independent rerun performed
unresolved: Direct replication with other intervention policies that reduce disruption d rather than only ROLLBACK/APPEND.
Cluster/dependence-aware evaluation when trajectory-level steps/interventions create stronger within-task dependence than the paper's task-level paired outcome analysis captures.
Whether deterministic or tool-grounded verification can materially lower disruption while preserving recovery on the same agents/tasks.
downstream_instruction: Retain the candidate as strong evidence that monitor accuracy cannot substitute for joint monitor+intervention end-to-end evaluation. Preserve the ALFWorld calibration nuance and distinguish the 50-task pilot estimates from the full 202-task outcome table.
